title: Horndeski Gravity (most general second-order scalar–tensor)
efc_relevance: Full Horndeski Lagrangian spans all consistent second-order scalar–tensor theories. GW170817 eliminated α_T ≠ 0 branches. EFC's 135k-point numerical scan (documented in FA3 hedge) shows standard quasi-static Horndeski with α_T = 0 cannot produce μ < 1 and Σ > 1 simultaneously — an EFC signature therefore falsifies standard Horndeski-QS. Discriminator structure is well-defined and recorded.
ledger_action: Logged as encompassing scalar-tensor competitor class. Cross-reference FA3 and conv_hi_class_scalar_tensor_efc_falsification_test.
